answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A anchor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tide of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
